title: The batch runner fans out agents in parallel to sort, lint and combine lanes, and combined PRs grow as large as conflicts allow
why: The owner feels batching is too small and serial; the batch runner should scale by using more sub-agents and merging more lanes together.
source: Owner ruling 20:39 CST Nov 13, relayed by the consultant (triage did not see it).
note: Triage 20:40 CST Nov 13: plan owed. The coordinator and runner 10 send a plan by 21:00 CST Nov 13. Shape from the ruling: parallel agents sort, lint and combine lanes; combined PRs grow as large as conflicts allow; merges stay serial. Not yet checked by triage: how many lanes runner 10 combines today (unmeasured), and which existing steps overlap (combined-pr-recipe, drain-batch-measure). Runner 10 20:43 CST Nov 13 (its word; unchecked by triage): plan sent to the coordinator at 20:43. Starts now: Explore agents sort the done-keep rows. Two points need a ruling. (b) Who may push "merge main in" to lane PR branches beyond the clean-merge overlap grant, and who posts lane lint comments. (c) Combined PRs built by Sonnet builder agents, each with a named tracking session and a branch slug. The merge lock stays serial. Merges are held until the coordinator says go.
